review_candidates.title: Lead Project Control Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Description WSP is one of the most diverse consulting firms globally and within Africa. To further our strategic business expansion plan, we are seeking new employees who are loyal, committed, competent, and proud to work for us. We are committed to achieving and maintaining diversity and equity in employment Key Role Act as a Project Controls Technical Authority within the Power and Energy business, providing strategic leadership, governance, and expert oversight of project and programme performance. The role supports high‑risk decision‑making, assures robust controls, and contributes to client advisory and work‑winning activities. Responsibilities Serve as the project controls authority for complex and high‑value energy and infrastructure programmes Define and govern project controls standards, methodologies, and assurance frameworks Provide expert oversight and approval of baselines, forecasts, and performance reporting Lead resolution of complex project controls challenges related to recovery, re‑baselining, and performance risk Provide strategic advisory support to clients on cost, schedule, risk, and controls strategy Support large‑scale project delivery through expert reviews and specialist inputs Contribute to work‑winning and proposal development, including controls strategies and delivery models Mentor senior project controls professionals and support capability development Ensure alignment with governance, financial control, and delivery excellence frameworks Health and Safety Role model standards for SHEQ performance and behavior consistent with the company’s health, safety, environmental, and quality vision and policies by influencing those around you Contributing to the identification of SHEQ risks and driving processes to achieve Zero Harm Embracing, displaying, and promoting the company values and ensuring a safe working environment is always maintained Qualifications BEng / BSc in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline 15+ years’ experience in project controls leadership on major energy or infrastructure programmes Recognised authority in project controls, planning, and performance management Professional certification (MSP, PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or equivalent) Key Competencies And Generic Skills Exceptional analytical and strategic judgement Strong leadership and decision‑making capability Excellent client‑facing and senior stakeholder engagement skills Ability to lead multidisciplinary project controls teams Uncompromising focus on governance, accuracy, and delivery excellence Additional Information What's in it for you? As well as rewarding you with competitive pay, WSP offers standard benefits including first class medical cover, generous days annual leave, and paid professional subscriptions. Be you, be happy - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects and maximizes the contribution individuals can bring to WSP. We recognize the benefits that people with varying backgrounds and experiences can bring. Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. We will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria.

review_candidates.title: Lead Civil Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Civil Subcontract Lead is responsible for managing civil subcontractors throughout the construction phase of power projects. The role ensures that subcontracted civil works are executed safely, on schedule, within contractual requirements, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project requirements. Key Responsibilities • Manage civil subcontractors from mobilization through execution, completion, and close-out. • Coordinate civil construction activities including earthworks, foundations, concrete structures, buildings, roads, drainage, underground networks, and associated infrastructure. • Review subcontractor work plans, manpower, equipment, schedules, and construction methodologies. • Monitor subcontractor progress against the approved project schedule and identify potential delays or performance issues. • Coordinate with Construction, Engineering, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, Contracts, Commercial, and Procurement teams. • Ensure subcontractors work according to approved drawings, technical specifications, method statements, and project procedures. • Monitor subcontractor productivity and recommend corrective or recovery actions when required. • Review and verify subcontractor progress and quantities in coordination with the relevant project teams. • Manage technical and construction interfaces between civil subcontractors and other disciplines. Participate in progress meetings and follow up agreed actions with subcontractors. • Support the evaluation of subcontractor variations, claims, scope changes, and contractual issues. • Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for subcontractor performance and progress. • Support subcontractor completion, punch-list clearance, handover, and close-out activities. • Ensure compliance with project HSE and quality requirements. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering. • Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience, preferably including significant experience in EPC construction projects. • Previous experience at Manager, Construction Manager, Subcontract Manager, or equivalent level. • Strong preference for candidates with experience in power plants, CCGT, substations, industrial plants, oil & gas, or major infrastructure projects. • Strong experience managing civil subcontractors and construction packages. • Good understanding of construction contracts, variations, claims, quantities, and progress measurement. • Strong coordination, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills. • Good command of English.

review_candidates.title: Key Account Sales Specialist
review_candidates.description: Vill du driva nyförsäljning i ett segment där affärsmannaskap, uthållighet och hög aktivitet gör verklig skillnad? GlobalConnect söker en nykundsansvarig säljare som vill bygga vår position inom fastighetssegmentet. Du kommer att bearbeta privata fastighetsägare, fastighetsbolag, byggbolag och nyproduktionsprojekt med fokus på fiber, nätverkslösningar och digital infrastruktur. Du är den som hittar, attraherar och stänger våra nya nyckelkunder. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har: Erfarenhet av proaktiv B2B/B2B2C-nyförsäljning, där du själv har prospekterat, öppnat dörrar och byggt pipeline Erfarenhet av att sälja fiberlösningar, nätverkslösningar eller annan relevant digital infrastruktur Erfarenhet av försäljning mot fastighetssegmentet, exempelvis fastighetsägare, fastighetsbolag, byggbolag eller nyproduktion Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift Vana av att driva längre säljprocesser med flera beslutsfattare Om rollen och teamet Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med att skapa nya affärer. Du ansvarar för att identifiera, kontakta och utveckla nya kunder inom ett segment där GlobalConnect vill växa och ta en starkare position. Du arbetar främst mot bolag i fastighetssegmentet med cirka 500–5 000 hushåll. Många kunder har redan befintliga avtal, vilket gör att försäljningen kräver tydlig behovsförståelse, affärsmässig höjd och förmåga att bygga förtroende över tid. Du blir en del av ett erfaret säljteam med kollegor i bland annat Stockholm, Östersund och Uppsala. Teamet har stark marknadskunskap och arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla bearbetningen av segmentet. Vi är öppna för sökanden som vill utgå från antingen Stockholm, Uppsala eller Göteborg. Det här kommer du att arbeta med Hitta och bearbeta nya kunder inom fastighet, bygg och nyproduktion Beräkna potentiellt affärsvärde för nya kunder genom att analysera investeringsbehov, lönsamhet över tid och relevant prisnivå Kontakta potentiella kunder via telefon, mejl, LinkedIn och nätverk Bygga en tydlig pipeline med prioriterade bolag och affärsmöjligheter Kartlägga beslutsfattare och driva dialog med flera personer hos kunden Presentera GlobalConnects fiber- och nätverkslösningar på ett professionellt och relevant sätt Driva säljprocessen strukturerat från första kontakt till signerat avtal Skapa och sedan underhålla våra nya nyckelkunder Vem vi söker Vi söker dig som är en tydlig hunter och doer. Du väntar inte på att affärer ska komma in, utan tar själv initiativ, skapar kontakt och driver processen framåt. Du är bekväm med olika kontaktägar och vet att nyförsäljning kräver både aktivitet och kvalitet, och har gott omdöme och anpassning till kunden och kontaktpersonen. Du är professionell, strukturerad och trygg i dialogen med fastighetsägare och beslutsfattare. Du kan skapa förtroende, förstå kundens affär och hålla momentum även i längre säljcykler. Det är meriterande om du har ett befintligt nätverk inom fastighet, bygg eller nyproduktion, samt förståelse för öppna nät, stängda nät eller fastighetsnära infrastrukturavtal. Låter det här som du? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig. Vår rekryteringsprocess TA-screening med Jessica Intervju med rekryterande chef Marcus Test Caseintervju med Marcus Referenser I den här rollen får du möjlighet att påverka GlobalConnects tillväxt i ett viktigt segment och kombinera aktiv nykundsbearbetning med långsiktig, professionell B2B2C-försäljning. Under sommaren kan du tyvärr förvänta dig en längre svarstid innan du får återkoppling, samt att processen tar längre tid än normalt - men vi hoppas du ändå kan tänka dig att söka! Du behöver inte skicka ett personligt brev – det räcker med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil. Bli en del av GlobalConnect och var med och utveckla den digitala infrastrukturen i norra Europa. Ansök idag! About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Job Description The Cluster Director of Engineering is responsible for providing strategic leadership, operational oversight, and technical governance for the Engineering & Safety functions across FRSS hotels by working closely with hotel leadership teams and stakeholders. The role ensures the reliability, safety, efficiency, and long-term sustainability of all engineering operations, assets, infrastructure, and building systems while maintaining compliance with company standards, brand requirements, and regulatory obligations. The Cluster Director of Engineering drives engineering performance, supports business objectives, and ensures that all properties maintain a safe, well-maintained, compliant, and guest-ready environment. Main Duties & Responsibilities Cluster Engineering Leadership & Governance: Provide a strategic leadership and oversight for the Engineering and Safety functions across FRSS hotels hotel, ensuring alignment with operational objectives, brand standards, and asset performance goals. FRSS are physically linked and share core utilities, hence, enable integrated operations and maintain engineering governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and performance standards to ensure consistency across FRSS hotels. Oversee the centralized shared functions such as Safety & Compliance, Central Store & Logistics, Workshops (Carpentry, Paint, MEP), PMP (Room Care Program) and Engineering command center. Lead, mentor, the robust succession & development of Engineering leaders and teams across FRSS hotels by centralized coaching and mentoring builds bench strength, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Engineering Operations & Asset Reliability One clear escalation path to ownership and asset management, reducing duplication, oversee the effective operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of all building systems, utilities, infrastructure, and engineering assets across FRSS hotels. Ensure the uniform application of Accor technical standards and MEP/FLS compliance at FRSS hotels. Ensure the implementation of preventive and predictive maintenance programs that maximize asset reliability, operational efficiency, and guest satisfaction. Monitor engineering performance metrics and operational KPIs, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance overall asset performance. Sustainability & ESG: Suggested incorporating energy efficiency and carbon footprint reduction goals aligned with Accor standards. Ensure specialized fire life safety, water hygiene, public health, and operational compliance regimes are implemented for Luxury Hotel - FRSS facilities in line with applicable KSA regulatory and public health requirements. Coordinate maintenance, testing, inspection, and contractor support for engineering assets to maintain safe, reliable, and guest-ready operations. Ensure to optimize resource deployment, technical manpower and specialist skills to where demands are highest across FRSS hotels. Capital Planning & Project Management Lead the development and execution of annual CAPEX plans, engineering budgets, and long-term asset replacement strategies across FRSS. Financial & CAPEX/OPEX Management: Suggested adding budget governance, energy cost optimization, and capital asset planning (essential for a Cluster Director role). Oversee engineering projects, renovations, upgrades, and new initiatives, ensuring delivery within approved budgets, timelines, and quality standards. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution and compliance with company requirements. Skills Strong leadership and people management capabilities. Excellent strategic planning and decision-making skills. Strong project management and execution skills. Financial acumen with the ability to manage budgets, forecasts, and cost optimization initiatives. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities across a portfolio environment. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. High level of organizational, planning, and change management capability.
